title: Figure frame: a picture slot above a hairline caption box with a mono FIG label and a caption
use: A figure in an article: a screenshot, diagram or chart in media with its FIG A label and caption. label_w sets the label cell, frame toggles the outer hairline.

label_w.note: width of the FIG label cell, units at 960

frame.note: hairline frame around the figure and caption

media.note: the figure (960 x 520, on the ground colour)

caption.default: Failure rate per hundred runs before and after pinning the clock; the dashed line is the old retry budget.

relations: Caption row 80 units high at the bottom under a hairline; the label sits in its own cell divided by a vertical hairline.
Caption sans 15.75 secondary grey, at most two lines; the figure sits on the ground colour.

provenance.corpus: benchlog case: our own original developer blog in the devlog-terminal grammar (post index, article with rail and header, figure frame, closing dot field), original copy and our own pixel glyphs
provenance.experiment: styles/devlog-terminal/style.json provenance (a public developer blog the owner named, read and measured privately in Chrome; never shipped)
provenance.method: The figure caption box of the article re-laid at 960 x 600.
measured: Reference: a hairline-bordered row with a mono FIG label and a caption sans 15.75 px #87867F.
